children.value: Overview
Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies in the US. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.
Engagement Details

Our client is a leading global professional services company that partners with businesses, governments, and organizations to build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services. With a presence in over 120 countries, they leverage cutting-edge technology, cloud, data, and AI, combined with deep industry expertise and global delivery capabilities, to deliver tangible value at speed and scale. Their success is measured by the 360° value they create for clients, employees, shareholders, partners, and communities.

Role Overview
We are seeking a SAP EWM Solution Architect to lead warehouse process optimization, business transformation, and digital innovation within supply chain execution. This role focuses on strategic process design, industry best practices, and emerging technology adoption to enhance warehouse efficiency and scalability.
Key Responsibilities
Design & optimize warehouse processes (inbound, outbound, inventory, labor) to enhance operational efficiency.
Align SAP EWM solutions with business strategy, ensuring scalability and future-proofing logistics operations.
Benchmark against industry best practices, driving process innovation and continuous improvement.
Execute a global EWM rollout roadmap, standardizing global processes while allowing regional flexibility.
Integrate SAP EWM with ERP (S/4HANA), TM, 3PLs, and automation systems for seamless operations.
Collaborate with business leaders, supply chain, and IT teams to ensure alignment with logistics goals.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations and sustainability initiatives in warehouse logistics operations.
Drive adoption of analytics & KPIs for warehouse performance tracking and decision-making.
Lead transformation initiatives, optimizing cost, efficiency, and customer fulfillment strategies.

Location: US only
Remote for the most part, may require a couple of weeks of travel to Singapore
What’s in it for you
Learn and evolve your skills using the latest and greatest technology tools in a rapidly growing company.
Learn from the best people around you. We constantly challenge the status quo and invent new ways of building a great product.
Work on challenging problems, innovate, and positively impact many people's lives while having fun doing it.
Required Qualifications
Upper-intermediate to fluent speaking and writing English. Able to have a real-time conversation.
5+ years of full-time hands-on SAP EWM experience.
5+ years of full-time hands-on ERP experience.
3+ years of full-time hands-on Tech Lead experience.
10+ years in supply chain execution, warehouse operations, or logistics solutions, with expertise in SAP EWM.
Industry Expertise: Deep knowledge of High Tech and 3PL logistics models.
Process Design Focus: Strong experience in warehouse strategy, logistics optimization, and network planning.
Stakeholder Engagement: Ability to bridge business needs with technology, influencing senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Nice to haves
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent demonstrated ability.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.
What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.
What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 55+ engineers going to 75+ by the end of the year. The current client size team is 600,000+ people. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.
What happens if the engagement is completed?
Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.
What are your core values?
Client First: we only win when our clients win. We treat client challenges as our own.
Ownership: we embrace responsibility, taking on challenges, getting them to completion, and enjoying getting things done.
Quality: we’re passionate about achieving quality outcomes by applying meticulous attention to detail.
